title: wordpress-nginx
description: The values of the wordpress-nginx chart, documented in values.yaml. Helm checks them against this schema on install, upgrade, template and lint. The schema is permissive on purpose. Text may come as a number and numbers as text, as --set and --set-string deliver them, switches as 0/1 or text, a list as a map of entries or as text, and a map as an empty list or, where the chart renders it as a template, as text; the chart reads such values as it always did. It refuses a mode other than the listed ones, a malformed entry of nginx.deniedPaths or wordpressPreinstallPlugins, a list or map where the chart reads a single value, and a single number or switch where it reads a list or map. Keys the schema does not list are left to the chart.

adaptSecurityContext.description: Adapt the securityContext sections of the deployment to make them compatible with Openshift restricted-v2 SCC: remove runAsUser, runAsGroup and fsGroup and let the platform use their allowed default IDs. Possible values: auto (apply if the detected running cluster is Openshift), force (perform the adaptation always), disabled (do not perform adaptation)

smtpPort.description: SMTP relay port (empty: msmtp's default, which is 25, or 465 with smtpProtocol "ssl")

smtpUser.description: SMTP username. Authentication switches on as soon as a user or password is set

smtpProtocol.description: Connection security: "tls" = STARTTLS (usually port 587), "ssl" = implicit TLS (smtps, port 465), "none" = unencrypted even with credentials (internal relays without TLS only), empty = unencrypted without credentials and STARTTLS as soon as smtpUser or a password is set. Any other value fails the render

smtpFromEmail.description: Sender address: becomes the envelope sender (msmtp --from) AND replaces the message's From header on the way into msmtp - transport-side rewriting, no code injected into WordPress. Required for relays that tie the sender to the authenticated identity (e.g. Office 365 rejects a mismatched header From with SendAsDenied). Empty: envelope and header stay whatever WordPress wrote (wordpress@<site host>)

smtpFromName.description: Human-readable display name for the rewritten From header ("Name <smtpFromEmail>"). Non-ASCII names are RFC 2047 encoded. Requires smtpFromEmail; setting it alone fails the render

smtpExistingSecret.description: The name of an existing secret with SMTP credentials
